C0800.title: 21st Century Business Herald Reports Third-Party Contractor Leak of Bank Customer Information
C0800.summary: A May 2026 21st Century Business Herald report on bank data security risks cited a case in which Xiaomeng, an employee of a company office in Karamay, was assigned to assist a bank with electronic banking marketing. She used that position to provide customer mobile numbers and verification codes to others through Douyin and WeChat groups for profit, selling more than 2,500 pieces of information and causing multiple bank customers information to leak. The court held her criminally liable for infringing citizens personal information. The case shows why third-party staff access to verification codes and marketing data needs least privilege and audit logging.
